title: Brazilian Fish Bowl
description: A light and refreshing dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine, featuring pan-seared fish and a tangy bowl.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix together the lime juice, Brazilian-style seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of cooked rice on the bottom, followed by a piece of fish, some mixed greens, sliced red onion, and diced tomatoes.
Drizzle the tangy lime juice mixture over the top and garnish with crushed peanuts.
